plans.question:
A first-person video of a walk across open ground past several objects. Look for the brown sphere, the only brown sphere here. At the end of the video, taking the camera's own facing as north (000 degrees), which compass bearing is it in? Answer in degrees clockwise from that forward direction, 0-359: 090 is directly to the right, 180 directly behind, 270 directly to the left.

Any integer from 0 to 359 is a valid answer — the object is usually not at an exact multiple of 90, so give your best estimate rather than rounding to the nearest quarter turn.
End your reply with exactly one line, and nothing after it:
ANSWER: <degrees>
